title: Her Voyage
tagline: Her Voyage is an empowering app designed for solo female travelers, providing reliable safety resources, community support, and verified accommodations. Protecting user privacy, it enables women to explore the world confidently and securely, transforming their travel experiences.
description:
Her Voyage is a pioneering app designed to revolutionize solo female travel by addressing the safety concerns that often deter women from exploring the world independently. Developed by Maria Fernanda Perez, a seasoned business analyst and passionate solo traveler, Her Voyage combines cutting-edge blockchain technology with a user-centric approach to empower women with confidence and security during their journeys.

At its core, Her Voyage offers a comprehensive suite of features tailored specifically for solo female travelers. From the moment users open the app, they are greeted with a welcoming interface and the empowering message, "Unleash Your Wanderlust with Confidence," inviting them to embark on their journeys with peace of mind. The app prioritizes user privacy by leveraging blockchain encryption to protect personal data, ensuring that women can explore destinations, find safe accommodations, and navigate transportation options securely.

Key features include a robust safety infrastructure that provides real-time alerts, emergency assistance via a dedicated SOS button, and a community hub where users can connect with fellow travelers for advice and support. Through verified safety ratings and interactive forums, Her Voyage not only enhances safety awareness but also fosters a sense of community among women travelers worldwide. The app's roadmap includes a phased rollout starting with platform development in Q3 2024, a testnet launch in Q4 2024, and strategic partnerships in Q1 2025, culminating in a full mainnet launch by Q2 2025 to expand its impact and reach.

Her Voyage is not just an app; it's a movement to empower women to embrace solo adventures confidently, break down barriers to safe travel, and promote gender equality in the global tourism landscape. Join Her Voyage in reshaping the future of travel safety and community for women everywhere.
how_its_made:
When developing the project, I started by creating a comprehensive Figma prototype to visualize the user interface and experience. Moving forward, the plan involves integrating with the Argent wallet, offering users the ability to earn rewards for contributing reviews and sharing critical safety information. To ensure the utmost security and privacy of user data, I opted to implement data encryption using StarkNet.

StarkNet was chosen for its robust features, including high throughput and scalability, which are crucial for efficiently handling a large volume of transactions. The use of zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) on StarkNet further enhances privacy by enabling users to prove specific knowledge without disclosing sensitive information, thereby minimizing data stored on the blockchain.

Moreover, StarkNet provides extensive developer tools, libraries, and documentation. These resources have been instrumental in simplifying the development and deployment of our decentralized application, ensuring a smooth and accessible experience for developers. This approach not only prioritizes security and privacy but also supports seamless integration with blockchain technology to deliver a reliable and user-friendly platform for our community of solo travelers.
